messages.Dodeljeni ekran nije priključen. Proveri: An assigned display is disconnected. Check Displays before starting; output will not be sent to another screen.
messages.U Ekranima izaberi bar jedan Notes ili S: In Displays, assign at least one output to Presenter View or Slides.
messages.Za izabrani raspored PowerPoint prikaza: To use this PowerPoint layout, allow StageDeck in macOS Screen & System Audio Recording, then reopen StageDeck.
messages.PowerPoint je pomerio prozor na kontroln: PowerPoint moved a window to the control display. Output was stopped to avoid showing the wrong content.
Wait for the previous command to finish.
messages.Fajl nije pronađen. Ponovo poveži ili za: File not found. Reconnect or replace the presentation.
messages.Dodeljeni ekran nije priključen. Proveri: An assigned display is disconnected. Check Displays.
Assign at least one display to Slides for PDF playback.
messages.PowerPoint prikaz još nije spreman. Prov: PowerPoint is still getting ready. Check for open dialogs in PowerPoint, then press GO again.
messages.Slideshow nije pokrenut. Proveri da li P: The slide show did not start. Check whether PowerPoint is waiting for confirmation or permission.
messages.Ekran je odvojen tokom pokretanja. Prove: A display was disconnected during startup. Check the layout and try again.
Wait for the command to finish.
messages.Aktivna prezentacija ostaje na svom tast: The active presentation stays on its assigned key until it ends.
messages.Prezentacija je promenila mesto. Ponovi: The presentation moved. Try renaming it again.
The presentation moved. Try editing it again.
A key label can contain up to 80 characters.
Close the presentation before changing displays.
messages.Ta prezentacija je već na drugom tasteru: That presentation is already assigned. Drag its key to the desired position.
messages.Identifikacija ekrana je dostupna kada n: Close the active presentation to identify displays.
messages.Instaliraj Elgato Stream Deck aplikaciju: Install the Elgato Stream Deck app, then try connecting again.
messages.Potvrdi instalaciju u Elgato aplikaciji,: Confirm installation in the Elgato app, then import the XL profile.
messages.Prečica je dostupna u instaliranoj aplik: The shortcut is available in the installed app.
Could not create the desktop shortcut.
The StageDeck shortcut is on your desktop.
messages.Stream Deck veza nije dostupna:: The Stream Deck connection is unavailable:
messages.Ekran je odvojen. Prikaz je zaustavljen;: A display was disconnected. Output stopped; check the layout before starting again.
This version supports up to three displays.
messages.Raspored je zaključan. Otključaj ga pre: The layout is locked. Unlock it before adding presentations.
messages.PowerPoint nije završio učitavanje na vr: PowerPoint did not finish loading in time. Check for open dialogs, then press GO again.
messages.Dozvoli StageDeck u System Settings → Pr: Allow StageDeck under System Settings → Privacy & Security → Accessibility to open PowerPoint Presenter View.
messages.Dozvoli da StageDeck kontroliše PowerPoi: Allow StageDeck to control PowerPoint and System Events under System Settings → Privacy & Security → Automation.
messages.PowerPoint integracija podržava Windows: PowerPoint integration supports Windows and macOS.
messages.PowerPoint nije odgovorio na vreme (: PowerPoint did not respond in time (
The Windows PowerPoint connection was interrupted.
messages.Za PowerPoint izlaze dozvoli StageDeck u: Allow StageDeck in macOS Screen & System Audio Recording to use PowerPoint outputs, then reopen StageDeck.
messages.prozor nije dostupan za prikaz. Zatvori: window is unavailable. Close any open Office dialogs and press GO again.
messages.PowerPoint izlaz nije poslao sliku na vr: The PowerPoint output did not send an image in time.
The PowerPoint video connection was interrupted.
messages.PowerPoint prozor je još otvoren. Zatvar: The PowerPoint window is still open. Press the same key to retry closing it.
messages.Sačuvaj postojeće izmene u PowerPointu p: Save your changes in PowerPoint before starting it from StageDeck.
messages.Prezentacija ima nesačuvane izmene. Saču: The presentation has unsaved changes. Save it in PowerPoint before closing.
PowerPoint did not open the selected file.
messages.PowerPoint prozor nije spreman. Ponovi G: The PowerPoint window is not ready. Press GO again.
messages.PowerPoint nije otvorio podešavanje proj: PowerPoint did not open slide show settings. Press GO again.
